item.title: Canterbury launches Doddie Weir tribute kit for 2025 Lions Tour
item.description: Canterbury of New Zealand, in collaboration with My Name’5 Doddie Foundation and The British & Irish Lions Trust, has launched a special-edition training kit ahead of the 2025 British & Irish Lions Tour to Australia. Proceeds from the kit will support the Foundation's mission to fund vital motor neuron disease (MND) research and provide care for those affected.

item.title: Opinion: Away ends could make or break the sport - but this is why it needs to be trialed
item.description: It's 3pm on a sunny English Saturday in April. Fans from opposite ends are singing songs, cheering on their team and jeering at the opposition. Security stands in high alert. A fierce battle is about to begin.

item.title: Lad ends up in Morocco on his own after losing fantasy rugby league
item.description: There’s a lot to be said about fantasy rugby. You join your mates in friendly competition as you prove who has the greatest knowledge of the game, either for a set prize or simply bragging rights.

item.title: F1 icon and London Irish owner Eddie Jordan passes away
item.description: Eddie Jordan, Former Formula 1 team owner and the man who led a consortium that recently purchased London Irish out of administration, has passed away at the age of 76.

item.title: Peato Mauvaka receives ban following Scotland incident

item.title: Ma'a Nonu breaks astonishing Top 14 record as he returns for Toulon
item.description: When Ma'a Nonu first burst onto the international rugby scene as a fresh-faced 20-year-old, many knew he had a bright future ahead. Just how impressive the next 22 years would be, was beyond anyone's prediction, however.

item.title: Rugby 25 slammed by fans: Claims of mis-selling over 'unfinished' game
item.description: This release was supposed to signal the long-awaited return of a truly complete rugby video game — arguably the first since the EA Sports Rugby 08 title. So, has the promise of an all-encompassing rugby simulation paid off?
